title: xDrip notification cascading
symptom: When swiping down from the top of the display, xDrip notifications are cascading (stacked) instead of being displayed as before. This behavior started with versions after February 14, 2020 and is reproducible on HTC U11 with Android 9.
cause: The issue is likely caused by commit 28d7b85 from PR #1101, as suggested by tolot27.
evidence_quote: It looks like it is caused by the commit 28d7b85 from PR #1101.
